description.en: Sets (or clears, with an empty string) the ambient environment sound loop for the current map.
Name of the ambient sound to play, or "" to clear it.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Clear the map's ambient environment sound
CMND_SET_MAP_ENV_SOUND("");
